statement: Let L be the set of all byte sequences t such that len(t) = len(s) and for every j with 0 <= j < len(s): if s[j] is a digit then t[j] = s[j]; if s[j] is a letter then t[j] = s[j] or t[j] = s[j] XOR 32 (i.e., t[j] is either the lowercase or the uppercase version of s[j]). Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a list of length |L| that contains every element of L exactly once (equivalently, r is a permutation of the elements of L).
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every s satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Let k be the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(s) such that s[j] is an ASCII letter. Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = 2^k.
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), len(r[i]) = len(s).
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(r) and every j with 0 <= j < len(s), if s[j] is an ASCII digit and j < len(r[i]), then r[i][j] = s[j].
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(r) and every j with 0 <= j < len(s), if s[j] is an ASCII letter and j < len(r[i]), then r[i][j] = s[j] or r[i][j] = s[j] XOR 32.
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every byte sequence t with len(t) = len(s) and with the property that for every j with 0 <= j < len(s): if s[j] is a digit then t[j] = s[j]; if s[j] is a letter then t[j] = s[j] or t[j] = s[j] XOR 32; there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(r) such that r[i] = t.
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i, j with 0 <= i < len(r) and 0 <= j < len(r), if r[i] = r[j] then i = j.
preconditions: 0 <= len(s) <= 12, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), an ASCII uppercase letter (65..90), or an ASCII digit (48..57).
